## What it catches

A file in a subject folder importing its own package's `index.ts` or `facade.ts`.

## As `layout({ scope: "@hosti/" })` builds it

```json
{
  "name": "subjects-do-not-import-package-root",
  "severity": "error",
  "from": {
    "path": "^(packages/[^/]+)/src/[^/]+/",
    "pathNot": [
      "^packages/[^/]+/src/adapters(?:/|$)",
      "^packages/[^/]+/src/(?:tests?|__tests__)(?:/|$)",
      "(?:^|/)(?:tests?|__tests__)(?:/|$)|[.](?:test|spec)[.][^/]+$"
    ]
  },
  "to": {
    "path": "^$1/(?:src/index[.]ts|src/facade[.]ts)$"
  }
}
```
